title: The $400 Typo
那筆四百元的手誤
paras: On the last day of the month, Hannah Cole, the {{accountant|accountant}} at a small design studio, had a long list. The {{quarterly|quarterly}} report was due Friday, and the printer's {{invoice|invoice}} was {{payable|payable}} within thirty days of receipt, which meant by Monday. She opened the {{spreadsheet|spreadsheet}} with last week's {{payroll|payroll}} first, to check it against the bank statement.
月底最後一天，一間小型設計工作室的會計漢娜．柯爾手上有一長串待辦事項。季報週五要交，印刷廠的請款單自收到起三十天內就得付款，也就是下週一前。她先打開上週薪資作業的試算表，要和銀行對帳單核對。

Halfway down the column, one number looked wrong. A typo had turned Ben Ortiz's $1,000 bonus into $1,400, so the company had {{overpay|overpaid}} him by $400. Hannah checked the file twice, hoping she was wrong. She wasn't.
看到那一欄的一半時，有個數字不對勁。一個打錯的字，把班．奧蒂茲一千元的獎金變成一千四百元，公司因此多付了他四百元。漢娜把檔案檢查了兩遍，希望是自己看錯，結果並沒有。

She didn't want to surprise him by email, so she walked over to his desk. "It was our mistake, not yours," she said. "But we need to {{deduct|deduct}} the extra money from your pay. If that's too much at once, we can take half from the next paycheck and the {{remainder|remainder}} from the one after." Ben shrugged. "Half and half is fine. Honestly, I thought the bonus was generous."
她不想用電子郵件嚇他一跳，所以直接走到他的座位。「這是我們的錯，不是你的錯，」她說，「不過我們得從你的薪水裡把多給的錢扣回來。如果一次扣太多，我們可以從下一次薪水先扣一半，剩下的從再下一次扣。」班聳了聳肩。「一半一半就好。老實說，我還覺得這筆獎金滿大方的。」

Back at her desk, Hannah fixed the cell and sent the report on time. Her boss, Mr. Grant, stopped by with his coffee. "Can't we {{automate|automate}} some of this?" he asked. "A formula that checks every payment against the contract would have caught that typo." Hannah smiled. She had been asking for exactly that for a year.
回到座位上，漢娜修正了那個儲存格，並準時交出報告。她的老闆格蘭特先生端著咖啡走過來。「這些作業能不能讓一部分自動化？」他問，「如果有個公式能把每筆付款和合約對照，那個錯字早就被抓出來了。」漢娜笑了。她已經要求這件事整整一年了。
